newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Hong Leong to sell unit to Man Yau.
newsitem.headline: Hong Leong to sell unit to Man Yau.

text.p: Malaysia's Hong Leong Properties Bhd said on Saturday it has proposed to sell its wholly owned property subsidiary to Man Yau Holdings Bhd for 57.6 million ringgit.
The national Bernama news agency quoted a Hong Leong statement as saying Man Yau would pay for 100 percent of Guobena Development Sdn Bhd by issuing new 10.28 million shares at 5.60 ringgit a share.
Guobena Development is a wholly-owned unit of Guobena Sdn Bhd, itself wholly-owned by Hong Leong.
Guobena Development owns a 10-storey office tower located in central Selangor state which is 70 percent completed.
The proposal is subject to revisions in the number of shares to be issued and their price by the Securities Commission, and agreed upon by the two parties.
Man Yau stock has been suspended since Oct 21, being last traded at 7.45 ringgit.
